sessions.phase_label: Initial assignments and NASM task reprioritization
Content production, new assignments, and quality-process clarification
Deadline adjustment, deliverable completion, and final study-guide assignment

requirements.title: CHPN Tests 1–4 Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the CHPN tests 1 through 4 as a distinct deliverable.
requirements.boundary_note: This is separate from other proofreading assignments because its source material, deadline, and completion are independently managed.

requirements.title: Florida Real Estate Tests Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the Florida real estate tests as a distinct deliverable.
requirements.boundary_note: This assignment has its own source material, deadline, and completion trajectory and is not merged with other proofreading work.

requirements.title: NASM CPT Heading Correction
requirements.definition: Correct the headings in the initially assigned NASM CPT document.
requirements.boundary_note: Heading correction is independently actionable from proofreading and image insertion, although it was initially bundled with the proofreading assignment.

requirements.title: NASM CPT Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the initially assigned NASM CPT document.
requirements.boundary_note: Proofreading is separated from heading correction and image insertion because each operation can be assigned, cancelled, or completed independently.

requirements.title: NASM CPT Heading-2 Image Insertion
requirements.definition: Add images for heading-2 subheadings in the designated NASM CPT file.
requirements.boundary_note: The designated file and heading-2 limitation are attributes of one image-insertion deliverable; chapter coverage and generated-image spelling validation are separate cross-cutting behaviors.

requirements.title: ALEKS Math Placement Review Material
requirements.definition: Create review material for the ALEKS math placement book using concise 400-word topic responses and the specified structural rules.
requirements.boundary_note: Word count, omission of introductions and conclusions, concise style, permitted tables and bullets, and the one-bullet limit are attributes of this single study-material deliverable.

requirements.title: LCSW Audiobook Formatting
requirements.definition: Format the LCSW audiobook as a distinct delivery task.
requirements.boundary_note: The evidence identifies a standalone formatting deliverable but does not establish more detailed formatting attributes.

requirements.title: Canada Citizenship Guide Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the Canada citizenship guide using the designated July 26 document and add new proofreading comments while disregarding pre-existing comments.
requirements.boundary_note: Document version selection and comment handling are mutable attributes of this specific proofreading deliverable rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: M1 Motorcycle Guide Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the M1 motorcycle document as a distinct deliverable.
requirements.boundary_note: This assignment is independently scheduled and can evolve separately from the other proofreading deliverables.

requirements.title: Ontario Driver License Book Image Insertion
requirements.definition: Generate and insert images for subheadings in the Ontario driver license book.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement owns the book-specific image deliverable and deadline; chapter-one coverage and spelling validation are independently applicable image-production behaviors.

requirements.title: Image Generation Starts from Chapter 1
requirements.definition: Begin image creation from chapter 1 for each book unless the client gives an explicit exception limited to a particular book.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a cross-book coverage rule that can fail independently of whether images were otherwise generated and inserted.

requirements.title: NASM Tests 2–4 Question Spacing
requirements.definition: Correct question spacing in NASM tests 2 through 4 and check the resulting PDF as part of the same document-cleanup delivery.
requirements.boundary_note: The PDF check is treated as a tightly coupled acceptance step for the spacing task rather than a generic standalone QA Requirement.

requirements.title: Generated Image Spelling Validation
requirements.definition: Inspect each generated image for spelling errors before insertion and regenerate any image containing an error.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently testable image-quality behavior, not generic QA: images may be generated and inserted while still violating the required spelling inspection and regeneration workflow.

requirements.title: Word-for-Word Proofreading Process
requirements.definition: Perform proofreading by reading every passage and line word for word rather than using a superficial review.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a cross-deliverable proofreading method explicitly required by the client and can be changed or assessed independently from any one book assignment.

requirements.title: Texas Driver License Study Guide
requirements.definition: Create review material for the Texas driver license source using concise 300-word topic responses and the specified structural rules.
requirements.boundary_note: This is separate from the ALEKS review material because it has different source material, word-count parameters, deadline, and completion trajectory.
